//: Set the project's Root Directory to `web` in Vercel, so this file and
package.json are found. One environment variable is required:
It is a server-side variable. There is deliberately no NEXT_PUBLIC_
anything in this application — the browser talks only to this app, so it
needs no address, no token and no key. CI fails the build if one appears.
Content-Security-Policy, HSTS and the rest are set per request in
middleware.ts, where the policy can carry a fresh nonce. Only the two
that cannot vary per request are declared here.
